segments.speaker: Data Analyst
segments.text: Yesterday I finished the revenue dashboard draft, but the retention query is slow and needs an index review.

segments.speaker: Engineering Lead
segments.text: I can review the retention query today and propose an index plan before end of day.

segments.speaker: Product Manager
segments.text: The launch readout is on Thursday, so we need the dashboard screenshots and a short narrative by Wednesday morning.

segments.speaker: Data Analyst
segments.text: I will prepare the screenshots after the query is fixed. The narrative is mostly ready and feedback has been positive.

segments.speaker: Engineering Lead
segments.text: Please flag any blocker by noon tomorrow so we do not surprise the launch team.
